title: A seat of one site cannot list, read, write, rename, delete or upload into another site's webroot through the Files tab (fs.*)
steps: S1: Run node --import tsx --test scripts/test/seat-isolation-files-tab.test.ts (a /site/{alpha,beta,alphabeta} tree with symlinks from alpha into beta).
S2: Read the summary lines of the run.
expect: S1: every gateway check denies a body naming a session the seat does not hold, on all eight fs.* routes; every plugin fence call aimed at beta (absolute path, '..', prefix sibling alphabeta, file and directory symlink, client cwd) throws forbidden 403; beta's files are unchanged.
evidence: #811 F-S3-003 flagged the Files tab isolation as best-effort; tasks/evidence/tracy-site-bugs-1110/seat-isolation/README.md
fence: dsh-passwords checkSeatBody (held session) plus dsh-better-sidebar path-security.ts / fs-operations.ts (session workspace root, realpath containment)
